card.name: Words right before supplement or diet
card.fires_on: Linking words and punctuation (and, or, of, a comma) just before an expected supplement, diet or nutrition word, in vitamin, nutrition or therapy text. Also fires partway through tryptophan and mcg.

modes.label: Linker before supplements
modes.description: A small word like and, or, of that sits where 'supplements' or 'diet' is likely to come next.
modes.example: higher intake of vitamin A from food<< and>> supplements have half the risk of developing stomach

modes.label: Diet and nutrition lists
modes.description: A joining word or comma inside phrases about diet, food and nutrition.
modes.example: WCRF and AICR, Food<<,>> nutrition and the prevention of cancer

modes.label: Partway through supplement names
modes.description: The middle of a supplement or unit name such as tryptophan or mcg.
modes.example: concomitant use of paroxetine with trypt<<oph>>an is not recommended

card.writes: It pushes the model toward supplement, diet and nutrition words and away from consume or consumption words.
card.plain: It lights up at the small word just before 'supplements' or 'diet' is likely to appear.
